constraints.description: Minimum 16 hours of rest between shifts (Morning 06-14, Afternoon 14-22, Night 22-06). A Night shift cannot be followed by a Morning or Afternoon shift on the next day, and an Afternoon shift cannot be followed by a Morning shift on the next day.
A staff member can only work at most 1 shift (8 hours) per calendar day.
Each shift must have exactly the required total staff count.
Each shift must meet the minimum number of required specialists.
Total assigned hours per staff member in the week must not exceed their max_weekly_hours.
No staff member can be assigned to a shift listed in their unavailable array.
